Koh. R. to IV, 8 גביני בן ח' G. b. H., a rich heir (cmp. preced.).

notas_originais: Y. Erub. V, 22 c (the Eastern gate) was called שער חריסית שהוא מכוון וכ' (corr. acc.) Gate of Ḥ., because it was facing the East; v. חֶרֶס II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) vaso de barro, quarto de dormir.
notas_originais: Tosef. Ter. X, 13; Tosef. Toh. V, 3; Y. Ter. XI, 48 a הריוסן (corr. acc.). [Ar. ed. Koh., s. v. הרסנא, reads הַרְסָן.]
, v. חַרְסוּם
, v. next w.

definicoes_originais: (חסף with ר inserted, v. חַסְפְּנִיתָא) scales.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 9, sq. Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 9 sq.—Pesik. R. s. 14 דמיין לחַרְסְפוּתַיָּיא דנוני, v. חַסְפְּנִיתָא; Pesik. Par., p. 35 a להחרפותא דיונה (corr. acc.).

notas_originais: Ned. I, 2.— Pl. חֲרָפִים, v. חֲרָפַיָּיא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); raspar, afiar, moer.; (cmp. חלף) mudar, transformar; para mudar de posse.; (de grãos) (de grãos) para ser moído; trnsf. ser deflorado, ter relações sexuais.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חלף) to change, transform; to change possession.
(of grist) (of grist) to be ground; trnsf. to be defloured, have intercourse.
(cmp. גָּרַף, גָּדַף) [ to scrape off,] to revile, blaspheme, shame.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. חָרוּף, f. חֲרוּפָה, pl. חֲרוּפוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 21 פנים ח' sharp (severe) countenance (Var. הדופות).—Trnsf. to deflour, v. infra.
Part. pass. f. חֲרוּפָה designated for change of condition, v. חֲרוּפָה.
Y. Kidd. I, 59 a top (expl. Lev. XIX, 20) נֶחֱרֶפֶת … בכתושה לפני איש ‘ne ḥ ĕ refeth by a man’ means crushed before a man (with ref. to Prov. XXVII, 22, v. הֲרִיפוֹת).

Kerith. 11 a (ref. to נחרפת explained by בְּעוּלָה) מאי משמע … דשנויי הוא (Rashi: דשינויא) what proof is there that ne ḥ ĕ refeth has the meaning of change from natural condition? Answ. ref. to הָרִיפוֹת (II Sam. XVII, 19) and to Prov. l. c.
Lev. R. s. 7, end מְחָרֶפֶת ומגדפת she (Rome) blasphemes and reviles. Num. R. s. 10 מְחָרְפָם, v. גָּדַף. Snh. 94 a, sq. שחי' ע"י וכ' who blasphemed (the Lord) through a messenger; a. fr.
Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV, end שמִתְחָרֵף ומתנאץ which is reviled and blasphemed. Ib. to Ps. XVIII, 1 עד שנִתְחָרַפְתִּי until I was reviled; a. e.
Tanḥ. B’resh. 12 (play on קיץ וחרף) שתהיו מתקייצין ופניכם מִתְחָרְפִין (some ed. מתחפרין) that you will feel nauseous and your faces become pale.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ; Pa.חָרֵף; afiar, moer.; blasfemar, insultar.; para ser rápido, chegue cedo.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. XIII, 20, sq. Targ. Job XVI, 9 (not חָרִיף; h. text ילטש).—Part. pass. מְחַרַף. Targ. Jer. IX, 7 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מְחָרֵיף, corr. acc.). Targ. Is. V, 28.
Targ. Y. Lev. XXIV, 11.; a. fr.—[Ib. 15, sq. יֶחֱרַף Pe.!]
Snh. 70 b אַחֲרִיפוּ ועולו וכ' go in early (before sunset), and leave early, that people may take notice of you. Sabb. 115 a דהוו קא מַחְרְפֵי that they did it earlier (than they were told to).
, v. חוֹרֶף

B. Bath. 90 b תרעא ח' וכ' the early market (soon after the crop) at the early market price, opp. תרעא אפלא later market.— Pl. חָרְפֵי. Targ. Koh. XI, 2 early seeds.—Taan. 3 b בח' concerning early clouds (when rain is gathering). Nidd. 65 b, v. אֲפֵילָא.— Fem. pl. חֲרָפָתָא. R. Hash. 8 a Ar. (ed. חָרְפְּיָיתָא), v. אֲפֵילָא.
Gen. R. s. 80. Sabb. 88 b, a. e. שומעין חֶרְפָּתָן וכ' hear themselves reviled and answer not.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. חֵרֶף) ḥărafaya, um substituto fonético de חֵרֶף no lugar de חֵרֶם.
definicoes_originais: (v. חֵרֶף) ḥărafaya, a phonetic substitute of חֵרֶף in place of חֵרֶם.
notas_originais: Ned. 10 b, v. חֲרָקַיָּיא.
v. חֲרָפָא; cmp. חוּרְפָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cap. = h. חֶרְפָּה. Targ. Sal. XXII, 7 חֶרְפַּת Sra. (ed. חִיסּוּדֵי).
notas_originais: ch. = h. חֶרְפָּה. Targ. Ps. XXII, 7 חֶרְפַּת Ms. (ed. חִיסּוּדֵי).
Targ. Y. II Deut. XIV, 18 (Y. I ערפדא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); cavar uma cavidade, cortar uma vala de largura uniforme em toda a extensão; decretar, designar.; para ser cortado, cavado, arado.
definicoes_originais: to dig a cavity, to cut a trench of even width all through.
to be cut into, dug, ploughed.
notas_originais: Y. Kil. VII, 31 b bot. חפר ח' נעץ וכ' if (on the Sabbath) one dug (a pit), made a trench, and cut a wedge-like ditch (narrow below), he is guilty of one act; Y. Sabb. VII, 9 d bot.; a. fr.

Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 1 (ref. to Job XIV, 5) ח' ימיו וכ' He designated the duration of life of every creature.— Part. pass. חָרוּץ, f. חֲרוּצָה; pl. חֲרוּצִים, חֲרוּצוֹת a) grooved. Sabb. 98 b ח' היו הקרשים וב' the boards of the Tabernacle were grooved, and the sockets hollowed out correspondingly.—b) decreed, decided; determined. Gen. R. s. 67 (ref. to Prov. XII, 27) the blessings שמעיקר העולם חרוצות לו which were designated to him from primeval days. Ib. חרוצה ביד וכ' it is a decided fact known to the righteous that they will in this world receive none &c. Deut. R. s. 1 שידיך חדות וח' that thy hands are quick and determined.—c) flat-nosed, v. חָרוּץ.
Y. Nidd. I, 49 a bot. a soil is called virgin כל שלא נ' בה מימיה when it has never been cut into; v. חֶרֶץ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , para cortar.; ser cortado, v. supra.
definicoes_originais: to be cut into, v. supra.
notas_originais: Part. pass. חָרִיץ. Gitt. 20 a רושמא מִיחֲרַץ ח' וכ' is the stamp of a coin dug into (are the devices formed with a loss of substance), or is it pressed into (by compressing the substance)?—Bekh. 41 a מיחרץ ח' (a dry scab is) cut into (deeper than the surface).

definicoes_originais: (preced.) incision, groove, mark of a seam.
notas_originais: Y. Nidd. I, 49 a bot. כל שאין בה ח' (a virgin soil is) such as shows no grooves. Y. Maasr. I, 48 d bot. משיתמלא הח' from the time the incision in the growing fruits begins to fill up.—Y. Bets. II, end, 61 d, a. e., v. חֲרִיץ.
B. Kam. 80 a (marginal version) שרצא ח' וא"ד ח' a digging animal, and some use only the word ḥ artsa: digger; v. חַרְזָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חֲרַץ); sulco, canal, v. חֲרִיצָא.; (cmp. כֶּסֶל) [incisão,] lombos.
notas_originais: Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 11 (Y. II חֶרֶץ).—Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 34 (Y. חַרְצוֹי pl.); a. fr.— Pl. חַרְצִין, constr. חַרְצֵי. Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 42 (some ed. חַרְצָן their loins); Y. ib. אתר קטור חַרְצֵיהוֹן חַרְצֵיהוֹן the place of the knot of their loins (belt). Targ. Y. Gen. L. 11; a. fr.
, v. חַרְצָנִיתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. חַרְצַנִּים (b. h.) um bagaço de grãos ou cascas de uvas; v.
definicoes_originais: , pl. חַרְצַנִּים (b. h.) a pomace of kernels or shells of grapes; v. זָג.
notas_originais: Naz. VI, 2. Ib. 35 a; a. fr.—Ib. 38 b אכל חרצן if he ate the shell (or the interior) of one berry. Ḥull. 82 b זרע חטה וח' if he sowed a wheat grain and a kernel; a. fr.—V. גּוּחַרְקָא II.
Y. Maasr. I, 48 d שתהא ח' שלהן וכ' their kernels must be seen through the berries.

Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 כהדא פרטתא דרמונא דח' מתחמיא מלגאו like the berry of a pome-granate whose stones are seen from within (shining through); Pesik. Vayhi, p. 3 b דחרצנייתא (read: דחַרְצִינִיתָא); Ex. R. s. 12 דחַרְצִינִיתֵיה; Num. R. s. 12 דחרצינתה (corr. acc.); Cant. R. to III, 11 דכל הדא פיטרתא (read: … חרצנתא); Yalk. Ex. 186 דחרצנתי (read: … תֵּיה); Yalk. Job 912 (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (próximo w.) [ fenda,] ḥ erek, um substituto fonético para ḥ erem (חֵרֶם).
definicoes_originais: (next w.) [ cleft,] ḥ erek, a phonetic substitute for ḥ erem (חֵרֶם).
notas_originais: Ned. I, 2.— Pl. חֲרָקִים, v. חֲרָקַיָּיא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) para cortar uma lacuna; espremer-se em uma lacuna; picar.; [para definir a borda,] (com שֵׁן) para ranger, ranger os dentes.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to cut a gap; to squeeze into a gap; to prick.
[ to set at edge,] (with שֵׁן) to gnash, grind the teeth.
notas_originais: Part. pass. חָרוּק, f. חֲרוּקָה; pl. חֲרוּקִים, חֲרוּקוֹת a) having incisions, edged, serried. Ḥull. 59 b ed., v. חָדַק.—b) wedged in. Par. XII, 8 החרוקות (Var. החֲדוּקוֹת) those handles which are squeezed into holes, opp. הקדוחות bored handles; Tosef. ib. XII (XI), 17 אף הרוק וצואה וכ' (read: אף החרוקות · צואה וכ').
Pesik. R. s. 37 מְחָרְקִין שיניהם ground their teeth (in sneer). Ex. R. s. 5; Tanḥ. Vaëra 6 התחיל מְחָרֵק עליהם וכ' he began to gnash his teeth against them (in rage).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Sab. 67 a לִיחֲרוֹק ביה פורתא deixe-o fazer um pequeno entalhe nele. Papel. חָרֵיק. Y. Kil. IX, 32c bot. וח' בשינוי e rangendo os dentes; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b וחרוק (corr. acc.).
notas_originais: Sabb. 67 a לִיחֲרוֹק ביה פורתא let him cut a little notch into it. Part. חָרֵיק. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot. וח' בשינוי and gnashing his teeth; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b וחרוק (corr. acc.).
same. Y. Kil. l. c. הויתא א' בשינייך thou wast gnashing thy teeth; Y. Keth. l. c. הוות א' בשינוי (corr. acc.).

. Ḥull. 59 b והוא דמיבלע חִירְקַיְיהוּ provided the edges of their horns run irregularly into one another. Sabb. 46 a דאית בה חרקי Ar. it has indentations (making the candlestick appear as if composed of movable parts), v. חדְקָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) [incisões,] ḥărakaya, um substituto caldeu de חֵרֶק que é em si um substituto de חֵרֶם.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) [ incisions,] ḥărakaya, a Chaldaic substitute of חֵרֶק which is itself a substitute of חֵרֶם.
notas_originais: Ned. 10 b what are the substitutes of ḥ erem? ח' חרכייא חרפייא Rashi (Ar. הר'; ed. חֲרָקִים &c., h. pl. of חֵרֶק &c.).
חֵרֵר (v. חוֹר I) to break through, to cave. Ohol. III, 7; Succ. 20 b חור שחֵרְרוּהוּ מים (or שחֲרָרוּהוּ) a cavity made by water, by animals &c.
— Part. pass. חֲרִיר discharging (v. חָרַיָּא). Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 3 חֲ' … ית וכ' (some ed. חָרֵיר part. act.) his membrum discharges &c.

חֵרֵר (denom. of חוֹר II) to set free.— Part. pass. מְחוֹרָר freed, free. Gen. R. s. 14, end (ref. to Gen. II, 7 נפש חיה) עבד מח' בפני עצמו וכ' (Var. מכודן, v. כָּדַן) a freed slave left to himself for a living.—Keth. 51 b; B. Kam. 95 a המְחוֹרָרִין (נכסים) unencumbered property. [Shaf. שִׁחֲרֵר.]
Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 2 אַחְרְרִינָהּ I will liberate her. Ib. 3 חֲרַרְתָּהּ (not … תא). Ib. 5.
Targ. Lev. XIX, 20.

definicoes_originais: [ to be rough, excited,] to glow.
notas_originais: Pilp. חִרְחֵר, q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , queimar, ficar enegrecido, carbonizado.; para atiçar o fogo.; para ser aquecido, seco.
definicoes_originais: , to burn, to be blackened, charred.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. II, 12 יֵיחוֹר. Ib. CII, 4. Targ. Ez. XV, 4, sq. חַר; a. e.
Ab. Zar. 38 b חָרוּרֵי, v. חֲרֵי.]
Targ. II Esth. V, 1.
same. Targ. Ps. LXIX, 4.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. חרר I) to heap up, round.
notas_originais: Denom. חֲרָרָה, חוֹרָר.
— Pa. חָרֵיר to round, make a חֲרָרָא. Targ. Ez. IV, 12 (some ed. תַּחְרְ' Af.; h. text תעגינה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: olho de agulha, v. חוֹר 1.; pilha, v.
notas_originais: — pl. חֲרָרִין, v. חֲרָרָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. = próximo w.,; um bolo.; coágulo.
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. VII, 13 (h. text צליל). Targ. I Kings XVII, 13 (h. text עגה); a. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 18 [read:] תמן אמרין עבדין מיניה ח' לכלבא ולא טעמיה there (in Babylonia) they say, they made out of it a cake for a dog, but he would not taste it (v. Erub. 81 a); Pesik. Haomer, p. 71 b חֲרָרָה.— Pl. חֲרָרָן. Targ. Y. I Num. XI, 8. Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 39 (some ed. חֲרִירָן; חרידן, corr. acc.).
Lev. R. s. 24 ח' דדמא (ed. חרדא, חרדה, corr. acc.) a clot of blood.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חרר IV) [pilha arredondada,]; um bolo grosso assado na brasa.; pilha de feixes, pilha temporária no campo.; חֲרָרַת דם um coágulo de sangue.
definicoes_originais: a thick cake baked on coals.
pile of sheaves, temporary stack in the field.
חֲרָרַת דם a clot of blood.
notas_originais: Kidd. 59 a, v. הָפַךְ (v. also Rashi a. l. a. infra). Sabb. I, 10. Tosef. Ḥag. III, 12; Y. ib. III, 79 b, v. תָּחַב. B. Kam. II, 3 שנטל ח' that took a cake (with live coals sticking to it).— Pl. חֲרָרִין. Bets. II, 6 (21 b) גריצין וח' Bab. ed., v. גְּרִיצָה (Mish. ed. חוֹרִי, Y. ed. חֹרִי b. h., collect. noun: cakes); Y. ib. 61 c bot. (play on חֳרִי, Deut. XXIX, 23, a. on חֹרִי, Gen. XL, 16).

Peah V, 8 לח' for the purpose of temporary piling, opp. לגוֹרֶן. [Kidd. 59 a עני המהפך בח' a poor man moving about a stack (waiting for its removal to take up eventually a forgotten sheaf); cmp. Peah l. c.; oth. defin. v. הָפַךְ.]—Y. Peah V, end, 19 a, expl. ח' with גַּלְגַּל a globular heap.
Bekh. III, 1 (21 b). Nidd. 66 a; a. e.—Tanḥ. K’dosh. 9 כחרדת (corr. acc.)
Kel. XI, 3 he who makes vessels מן הח' of iron ore (before it is smelted).
, v. חֶרֶס

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); gravar, desenhar, desenhar.; arar.; para ser arado.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to I, 16 הלב חוֹרֵשׁ the heart designs.

Macc. III, 9 יש חוֹרֵשׁ תלם וכ' one may plough one bed and &c. Taan. 29 a וח' את העיר Ms. M. and passed the plough over the city of Jerusalem. Sabb. VII, 2; a. fr.—Trnsf. to have sexual intercourse. Y. Yeb. I, 2 b top. Gen. R. s. 98; a. e.
Taan. IV, 6 נֶחְרְשָׁה העיר the plough was passed over the city of Jerusalem; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pi.; mesmo. B. Kam. 86 mesmo.; (bh) ficar em silêncio.; tornar-se surdo (e mudo).
notas_originais: חֵרֵשׁ, חֵי' (denom. of חֵרֵשׁ) to deafen, make deaf. B. Kam. 86 a שחֵירְשׁוֹ וכ' when he made him deaf without wounding him. Ib. החוֹרֵשׁ את אביו (Ms. H. a. R. חֵרֵשׁ); ib. 98 a חֵרְשׁוֹ לאביו if one injured his father’s hearing; v. חֲרִישָׁה II. Kidd. 24 b.—Sabb. 109 a top. יד מְחָרֶשֶׁת the unwashed hand put to the ear causes deafness.
B. Kam. 86 a להַחֲרִישׁ, v. חֲרִישָׁה II.
Y. Pes. IX, end. 37 a (ref. to Prov. XVII, 28) ואין צ"ל חכם מַחֲרִישׁ and it is needless to say the same of a wise man keeping silence. [Usu. שָׁתַק.]
Yeb. XIV, 1; Tosef. Ter. I, 1 פיקח ונ' if he had been well-hearing and became etc.; v. חֵרֵשׁ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido. wds.); estar emaranhado.; estar sufocado, obstruído, surdo.; para praticar bruxaria.
notas_originais: . Targ. Job VIII, 17.
Gen. R. s. 81 (prov.) מהולתך חַרְשָׁה וכ' if thy sieve is choked, knock at it (when you are forgetful of your duties, the Lord will remind you through affliction); v. טְרַשׁ II.
Ib. s. 86 באתר דחרשין חֲרִישִׁין where there are sorcerers witchcraft is practiced.
Targ. Ez. XIII, 20 (h. text צדד).
Y. Hag. II, 77 c top (expl. תאלמנה, Ps. XXXI, 19) יִתְחַרְשָׁן וכ' may their lips be confounded, crushed, silenced, cmp. אִלֵּם a. חֵרֵשׁ; Gen. R. s. 1 (corr. acc.)

Deut. R. s. 2 לח' שהיה וכ' like an artist that was making an image &c.— Pl. חָרָשִׁים. Gen. R. s. 65, end; s. 70, v. חֲמוֹר; Pesik. Shek., p. 15 a.—Trsnf. scholar. Gitt. 88 a (ref. to II Kings XXIV, 16) חָ' שבשעה … כחֵרְשִׁין the scholars were named ḥ arash, for when they opened argument, all were like dumb; Snh. 38 a; Yalk. Dan. 1066; a. e.— Pl. as above. Ḥag. 14 a (ref. to Is. III, 3).
Tanḥ. Sh’mini 9 (play on חָרָשׁ, II Kings XXIV, 16) אלו … תפלת ח' בלחש וכ' ḥ arash means those who hold silent prayers in murmuring, and yet conquer &c.
Ab. IV, 15. Yoma 4 b; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [fechado,] surdo, mudo (cmp. אִלֵּם); surdo e mudo.; עשו עצמכם ח' finge ser surdo.
definicoes_originais: [ closed up,] deaf, dumb (cmp. אִלֵּם); deaf and dumb.
עשו עצמכם ח' pretend to be deaf.
notas_originais: Ter. I, 2 ח' שדברו וכ' the ḥ eresh of which the scholars speak (in a legal sense) means everywhere deaf and dumb. Ib. ח' המדבר וכ' a ḥ eresh that can talk but not hear. Meg. II, 4 חוץ מח' except a deaf person. Sifré Num. 153 (ref. to Num. XXX, 5; 12) להוציא את הח' this excludes the case of the father (the husband) being deaf; Ned. 73 a; a. fr.— Pl. חֵרְשִׁים, חֵרְשִׁין. Ḥag. 14 a; Gitt. 88 a, v. חָרָשׁ. Ruth R. s. 2 beg. (ref. to חרש, Josh. II,
— Fem. חֵרֶשֶׁת. Gitt. V, 5. Yeb. XIV, 1; a. e.— Pl. חֵרְשׁוֹת. Ib. 3.

Targ. Ex. IV, 11; a. fr.— Pl. חֵרְשִׁין, חַרְשַׁיָּא. Targ. Is. LVI, 10; a. e.—Y. Ber. IX, end, 14 d כל חרשייא טבין וכ' Var. (v. כַּדָּבָא) all dumb (silent) persons are good, but those silent (abstaining) from reciting the Law are bad.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. חֶרֶשׁ; cmp. לַחַשׁ) fascinador, encantador, feiticeiro.
definicoes_originais: (v. חֶרֶשׁ; cmp. לַחַשׁ) fascinator, charmer, sorcerer.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Deut XVIII, 10 (some ed. חֲרָשׁ); a. e.—Cant. R. to III, 6. Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d bot. עיסקיה דהדין ח' וכ' it is the nature of a sorcerer that he can do nothing when lifted from the ground. Ber. 62 a bot. (in an incantation) לא חַרְשֵׁי דח' וכ' (Var. דחָרָשֵׁי … pl., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l, note 8) no charm of a sorcerer or of a sorceress.— Pl. חָרָשִׁין, חָרָשַׁיָּא, חָרָשֵׁי, חֲרָ'. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c. (ed. Amst. חַרְשִׁין). Targ. Ps. LVIII, 6; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. l. c.; Y. Snh. VI, 23 c bot.— Fem. חָרָשָׁא חֲרַשְׁתָּא,. Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 17.—Ber. l. c. (Var. חַרְשִׁיתָא).—V. חַרְשִׁין.
f. same. Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 17; a. e.—V. חֲרוּשְׁתָּא

Targ. Koh. XI, 4 (ed. Amst. חֲרָ'); a. fr.—Sabb. 75 a, v. אַמְגּוּשְׁתָּא. Ber. 62 a bot., v. חָרָשָׁא. Cant. R. to III, 6 לית ח' מצלחין וכ' (not חרשון) witchcraft has no effect by night. Gen. R. s. 86 ח' במצרים sorcery imported to Egypt!, v. חֲרַשׁ 3.—Ḥull. 84 b; B. Mets. 29 b כסא דח' וכ' rather drink a cupfull of witchcraft (charmed drink) than of tepid water. Pes. 110 a, v. next w.
Ber. 62 a, v. חָרָשָׁא.— Pl. חַרְשָׁיָין, חַרְשְׁיָיתָא. Y. Hag. II, 77 d bot. נשיין ח' women practicing witchcraft. Pes. 110 a נשי ח' Rashi (ed. נשי דחרשייא, Ms. M. דחרושתא), v. חֲרוּשְׁתָּא.
, v. חָרָשָׁא
Part. pass. חָרוּת, v. חֵירוּת

verbetes.glosa_atual: Papel. passar. חָרִית, pl. חֲרִיתִין. Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 28 (ed. Berl. חֲרִיתִּ'). Targ. Jer. XVII, 1.
notas_originais: Part. pass. חָרִית, pl. חֲרִיתִין. Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 28 (ed. Berl. חֲרִיתִּ'). Targ. Jer. XVII, 1.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חרר III) fuligem, sedimento de tinta, sapato preto.
definicoes_originais: (חרר III) soot, sediment of ink, shoe-black.
notas_originais: Nidd. II, 7 כח'; ib. 19 a כחָרוּת; Tosef. ib. III, 11 (not בה'); expl. Nidd. 20 a כי חרותא דדיותא, v. דְּיוּתָא.—Y. Sot. VII, 22 d חָרוּתָהּ אש וכ' its ink was black fire. Y. Kil. IX, 32 a top פשתן שצבעו בח' (ed. בחרם, corr. acc.) linen dyed with blacking (looking like wool).
Sabb. 104 b; Gitt. 19 a, v. אוּשְׁכָּפָא. Lam. R. to IV, 8.
Targ. Prov. XV, 18; XVIII, 6 (ed. Lag. הַרְתָּא).
, v. חוּר'
— Pl. חָרָתָא. Yeb. 118 b בי ח' among the women of nobility; Keth. 75 a חָרָאתָא.
Targ. Prov. XVI, 28 (ed. Lag. הַ'; some ed. דרתנא, incorr.)
, v. חוּשׁ, חָשַׁשׁ, חֲשַׁשׁ.
, v. חֲשִׁי

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ou חַשָׁא) m. (חוּשׁ, חֲשַׁשׁ; cmp. P. Sm. 139; o que o homem tem que sofrer, predestinação, sorte.
definicoes_originais: (or חַשָׁא) m. (חוּשׁ, חֲשַׁשׁ; cmp. P. Sm. 139
what man has to suffer, predestination, luck.
notas_originais: — Pl. חָשַׁיָּא or חַשַּׁ'. Lam. R. to I, 16 דחָשַׁיֵּיה קשיי לינוקי hard fates are in store for my child (Matt. K. quotes a version נחשייה, v. נַחֲשָׁא). Ib. [read:] לא אמרית לך דח' קשייא ליה דעל ריגליה חרב בית מקדשא.
Sabb. 128 a, expl. קורניתא (v. Löw Pfl. p. 181).

Pes. 56 a להביא בח' to offer it to her in secret. Ib. שיהו אומרים … בח' that they say it in a whisper. Arakh. 16 a; Zeb. 88 b; Yoma 44 a דבר שבח' something done in secrecy (the offering of frank-incense on the inner altar); מעשה שבח' what is committed in secrecy (calumny). Ber. 15 b; a. fr.— Pl. חֲשָׁאִים. Shek. V, 6 לשכת ח' the Hall of Secret (donations).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Sal. XLI, 8. Targ. Jó IV, 16; um. e.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. XLI, 8. Targ. Job IV, 16; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pensar, pretender, planejar.; considerar, considerar; contar.; projetar, rastrear.; mesmo
definicoes_originais: to consider, regard; to respect, v. supra.
(sub. מחשבה זרה) to have in mind an undue intention in the performance of a sacrificial ceremony.
to be considered, believed to be.
notas_originais: Ber. 6 a; Kidd. 40 a (ref. to Mal. III, 16) אפי' ח' אדם וכ' even if one only had the intention of doing etc.; Sabb. 63 a חִישֵּׁב ( Pi.).—Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 וכשהן חוֹשְׁבִין להעמידו וכ' and when they thought they had put it up, it fell apart again. Sot. 35 a אני חֲשַׁבְתִּיהָ … והם חָשְׁבוּ וכ' I planned it for their good, but they considered it an evil; a. fr.
Ber. 14 a (ref. to Is. II, 22) במה חֲשַׁבְתּוֹ לזה ולא לאלוה with what right didst thou pay thy regard to him and not to God?—Sot. l. c., v. supra. Pesik. R. s. 21, v. סוֹפִיסְטָא; a. fr.

Yoma 72 b (ref. to חשב a. רקם, Ex. XXVI, 31 a 36) רוקמין במקום שחוֹשְׁבִין they embroidered over what they had traced.— Part. pass. חָשׁוּב fem. חֲשׁוּבָה a) counted, regarded; ח' כ־ equal to. Lam. R. to I, 5 לא … מדינה ח' כלום the country towns were of no account. Ned. 64 b ח' כמת is like dead; ib. חֲשׁוּבִין כמת; Gen. R. s. 71 חֲשׁוּבִים כמתים; a. fr.—b) valuable; important; respectable, of high standing. Bets. 3 b ביצה ח' an egg is a valuable object. Ber. 19 a, a. fr. אדם ח' שאני with a man of high standing it is different. Pes. 108 a אשה ח' a woman of rank. Tanḥ. Shmini 9 איש ח' שמחשבים וכ' a man of standing whom they respected in his place; a. fr.

B. Bath 78 b המְחַשְּׁבִים the thoughtful. Sabb. 150 a. חשבונות … לחַשְּׁבָן וכ' accounts of a religious nature may be figured out on the Sabbath. Ab. II, 1 הוי מְחַשְּׁב וכ' count what you sacrifice in doing good, against what you gain thereby. Snh. 65 b המח' עתים וכ' he who calculates seasons and hours (which are auspicious and which are not). Ib. 97 b מְחַשְּׁבֵי קיצין those who make calculations (from Biblical verses) as to when the Messiah will come; a. fr.—[Sabb. 150 b top מותר לחוֹשְׁבָן (Kal), Ms. M. לחַשְּׁ'.]—V. חֶשְׁבּוֹן.
Yoma 48 a חי' בחפינת וכ' if he had an undue intention when grasping the frankincense (e.g. to offer it tomorrow). Ib. b; a. fr.

Ohol. I, 3 אין האהל מִתְחַשֵּׁב the tent is not counted (as a special item). Yalk. Num. 768 מתח' לנו will be counted against us (be deducted from our share). Mikv. III, 3 עד שיִתְחַשֵּׁב וכ' until it is calculated that all the original water has run off. Pesik. R. s. 44 the former sins אינן מִתְחַשְּׁבוֹת לו וכ' are not counted or remembered to him.
Tanḥ. Masé 5, v. כַּזְבָּן.
Shebi. VIII, 11 אם מתחשב הוא (Ms. M. כמ', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if he (is like one who) holds a high position.

Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 7 ואם מתחשב וכ' but when he (the Israelite besieging a city) does it as an ally (in the Roman interest), he is forbidden (to conduct the siege); Ab. Zar. 18 b ובלבד שלא יִתְחַשֵּׁב עמהם provided he does not conspire with them; ואם נתח' וכ' (Ms. M. יתח'); Y. ib. I, 40 a מתחשד (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: mesmo, planejar, contar, calcular.; .; a ser planejado.; ser considerado, valorizado.
definicoes_originais: same, to plan, to count, calculate.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. L. 20. Targ. Esth. VIII, 3; a. fr.—Pesik B’shall., p. 82 a (translating Ex. XVIII, 11 b) במחשבה דחַשְׁבוּן איתחשב להון what they had planned (against Israel) was planned against them. Sabb. 3 a קא חֲשִׁיב he counts in; a. fr.— Part. pass. חָשִׁיב, pl . חֲשִׁיבִין = h. חָשׁוּב, v. preced. Targ. Y. Ex. IV, 19; a. fr.—Keth. 8 b ח' את וכ' thou hast been found worthy to be seized (to suffer) for etc. Gitt. 56 b מאן ח' וכ' who is highly esteemed in that world (the hereafter)?; a. fr.

Targ. Jer. XXI, 11.—Targ. O. Lev. XXV, 27; a. fr.—Meg. 11 b חַשִּׁיב ועייל וכ' count, and include in their place &c. Pes. 94 a דקא חַשְּׁבֵי דקדמא וכ' because they also counted the distances which one walks before dawn and after sunset. Sabb. 74 a וליחַשֵּׁב וכ' let him also count the act of pounding; ib. 6 b; a. e. ולִחְשׁוֹב (Pe.); a. fr. [Y. Pes. IV, end, 31 c מחשבנא v. חֲשַׂךְ.]
אִיחֲשַׁב
. Targ. O. Gen. L, 20.—Pesik. l. c., v. supra.
Targ. Lev. XVII, 4. Targ. Ps. L, 23; a. fr.—[Targ. Prov. XXIX, 11 מֵיחֲשַׁב Ms. (ed. Lag. מחשב, Var. מאשב) is respected (v. Pesh. a. l.; ed. Wil. מאכה v. מְאַךְ).]
— Pl. (חֲשָׁ') חַשָּׁבַיָּא. Targ. Is. XXXIII, 18.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.); conta, soma; responsabilidade; punição e recompensa.; agilidade nos negócios.
definicoes_originais: account, sum; accountability; punishment and reward.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 9 b ח' גדול sum total. Ib. 78 b (play on Ḥ eshbon, Num. XXI, 27; 30) באו ונחשב חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹ וכ' come and let us examine the account of the world (human affairs), the loss etc. Ib. אבד ח' וכ' the accountability of the world is gone (there is no reward or punishment). Ex. R. s. 51, beg., a. fr. ליתן ח' to render an account. Tosef. B. Kam. X, 21 מה ח' עשה וכ' how our father settled with yon; Y. ib. X, 7 b bot.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42 a top ח' מים וכ' he understands the calculation of the action of the water. Ib. ח' גדול הוא this is a great thing to calculate; a. fr.

Deut. R. s. 4 איני מכיר חֶשְׁבּוֹנְךָ I do not know your way of settling (whether you are prompt); ib. עשית לי ח' טוב you paid me promptly. [Yalk. Deut. 808 הח' read בעל הח' market commissioner.]— Pl. חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת. Sabb. 150 a, sq., v. חָשַׁב. Bekh. 5 a בקי בח' a good arithmetician.
, v. חוּשְׁבָּנָא
, v. חָסַד II

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חָשָׁה) [ sussurrar,] suspeitar (cmp. דּוּם a. דִּימָה).; ser suspeito.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חָשָׁה) [ to whisper,] to suspect (cmp. דּוּם a. דִּימָה).
notas_originais: Yoma 19 b, a. e. החוֹשֵׁד בכשרים he who entertains a suspicion against worthy men. Ib. חֲשָׁדוּהוּ (ב)צדוקי they suspected him of being a Sadducee. Sabb. 127 b במה חֲשַׁדְתַּנִי whereof did you suspect me?—Ib. 118 b; M. Kat. 18 b מי שחוֹשְׁדִין וכ' whom people suspect without cause; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָשׁוּד, f. חֲשׁוּדָה; pl. חֲשׁוּדִים, חֲשׁוּדִין; חֲשׁוּדוֹת. Dem. III, 5, v. חָלַף. Erub. 69 a ח' לדבר אחד ח' וכ' one who is suspected of neglecting one religious law, is suspected of disregarding the whole Law; Bekh. 30 b. Ib. a ח' על השביעית suspected of ignoring the laws of the Sabbatical year. Shebu 32 b, a. fr. ח' על השבועה suspected of swearing falsely (not admitted to oaths). Y. Taan. III, beg. 66 b מפני פרנסת ח' for the sustenance of those suspected (of neglecting the laws of the Sabbatical year); a. fr.

Ber. 31 b (ref. to I Sam. I, 16) מבאן לנ' בדבר וכ' from this we learn that he who is unjustly suspected, must make it known (clear himself). Bekh. 30 b; Ab. Zar. 39 a עד שיֵחָשְׁדוּ until there is reason to suspect them of neglecting the observances of the associates (v. חָבֵר); a. fr.—[Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40 a מתחשד, v. חָשַׁב.]

Targ. Y. Deut. XXIV, 9.—Sabb. 118 b לדידי חַשְׁדָּן וכ' they suspected me without cause; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָשִׁיד. Ber. 5 b ומי חֲשִׁידְנָא וכ' am I suspected by you (of doing wrong)?; ומי ח' קב"ה וכ' can the Lord be suspected of injustice?, v. דִּינָא. Shebu. 32 b דח' מאן which of the contestants is suspected (of swearing falsely)?; a. fr.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 3.
— Pl. חֲשֵׁדִים; constr. חֲשֵׁדֵי. Pes. 85 a ח' כהונה the suspected among the priesthood, i.e. priests suspected of wilfully unfitting a sacrifice in order to spite the owner.
מפני הח' to avoid suspicion. Sabb. 23 b מפני הח' (Tosef. Peah I, 6 מפני מראית העין) to avoid suspicion (as if he appropriated to himself the poor man’s share). Yoma 30 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Bruxa. 5 a מייתי לה לידי ח' a expõe a suspeitas.—משום ח' para evitar suspeitas. Ber. 43b; um. frag.—
notas_originais: Ḥag. 5 a מייתי לה לידי ח' exposes her to suspicion.—משום ח' to avoid suspicion. Ber. 43 b; a. fr.—
, v. חשי
Keth 84 b bot. יימר בר ח'.
, v. חָשַׁב

Ab. Zar. 8 a, v. חָשַׁךְ.— Pl. חֲשׁוּכִּים, כִּין …; f. חֲשׁוּכּוֹת. Bekh. VII, 5 (expl. מרוח אשך, Lev. XXI, 20) שמראיו ח' whose complexion is very dark. Yalk. Ex. 258 פנים ח' dark (frowning) countenance; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 2 חֲשֵׁכוֹת.
Pesik. R. s. 6, beg. (ref. to Prov. XXII, 29) פרעה הח' Pharaoh, the benighted.— Pl. as ab. Cant. R. to I, 1 (ref. to Prov. l. c.) לפני ח' אלו הרשעים ‘before the benighted’ that means the wicked.

verbetes.glosa_atual: .; mesmo, escuro.; (חֲשַׁךְ II) magro, reduzido, pobre.
notas_originais: . ch.
. Targ. Am. V, 20.
v. חֲשִׁיךְ II.

Targ. Ex. X, 21, sq.; a. fr.—Targ. Ez. XIII, 18, v. רְקִיעָא II.—Pes. 34 b ארעא דח' a land of darkness (fogs). Ḥag. 12 b bot. ומי איכא ח' וכ' is there darkness before the Lord?; a. fr.— Pl. חֲשׁוֹכַיָּא. Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 7.
Bets 32 a עדויי ח' Ar. (ed. חוּשְׁכָּא). v. מָחַט.
, Tanḥ. P’kudé 3, some ed. (oth. ed. חצוף), read סָחוּף, v. סָחַף
, v. חֲשִׂיפָה
, v. חֲשַׁשׁ

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [sussurrar,] ficar em silêncio, quieto (cmp. דום, דמם).
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to whisper,] be silent, quiet (cmp. דום, דמם).
notas_originais: Part. (fr. חוּשׁ) חָשׁ, f. חָשָׁה, pl. חָשׁוֹת. Ḥag. 12 b אומרות … וחשות ביום וכ' say praise by night, and are silent by day. Ib. 13 b (play on ח̇ש̇מ̇ל̇) חיות עתים ח̇ש̇ות … ממ̇ל̇לות Ms. M. Ḥ ayoth (v. חַיָּה I end) who at times are silent etc.
